file.name: Built-in · file
file.desc: File tools: read, write and browse workspace files

exec.name: Built-in · exec
exec.desc: One-shot execution: each command or script starts a fresh process and exits when done (stateless; includes skill scripts via run_skill_script)

shell.name: Built-in · shell
shell.desc: Persistent session: a long-lived process is reused, so cwd / environment variables / background jobs survive across calls

script.name: Built-in · script
script.desc: Skill scripts: runs only scripts inside the skill directories mounted read-only for you

browser.name: Built-in · browser
browser.desc: Browser tools: operate web pages inside the sandbox (network access, can read page content — high risk)

agent.name: Built-in · agent
agent.desc: Agent tools: inspect and call other agents

skill.name: Built-in · skill
skill.desc: Skill tools: list and view the skills injected for you (read bodies on demand with read_skill or use_skill; use_skill also activates their tool dependencies)

skill-own.name: Built-in · skill-own
skill-own.desc: Private skills: create, update or delete your own skills (this writes your own capability surface; not granted by default)

agent-admin.name: Built-in · agent-admin
agent-admin.desc: Agent admin (supervisor only): create, update or delete agents and bind skills to them

skill-admin.name: Built-in · skill-admin
skill-admin.desc: Skill admin (supervisor only): create, update or delete tenant-wide shared skills, and other agents' private skills

tool-grant.name: Built-in · tool-grant
tool-grant.desc: Grant admin (supervisor only): grant or revoke an agent's tools, and agent-to-agent call relations

custom-tool.name: Built-in · custom-tool
custom-tool.desc: Custom tool admin (supervisor only): create, update, delete or list this tenant's custom tools

flow-admin.name: Built-in · flow-admin
flow-admin.desc: Workflow admin (supervisor only): create, list, read, delete and test-run workflows, view run records, and expose flows as MCP / RPC endpoints

super.name: Built-in · super
super.desc: Supervisor only (legacy aggregate group, equivalent to the union of the five admin groups)

default.name: Standard toolkit
default.desc: Tools a new agent gets by default: read and write its own workspace, inspect agents and skills, call other agents (no command execution)

plugin.name: Plugins
plugin.desc: Python tool plugins on disk (one tool, several implementations, enabled per tenant)

custom.name: Custom tools
custom.desc: Code tools this tenant built itself (grant ref = custom:<name>; model-side tool name custom__<name>)

rpc.name: Local RPC endpoints
rpc.desc: RPC-protocol endpoints of this tenant's workflows (agent-to-agent calls go through call_agent)

toolDetail.title: Tool details
toolDetail.noParams: No declared parameters — this tool takes no input; pass an empty object when calling it.
